## Read order (new agent)

1. [`0A_agent.md`](0A_agent.md) — active handoff / agent entry point, start here
2. [`01_overview.md`](01_overview.md) — what this project is and why it exists
3. [`04_plan.md`](04_plan.md) — the 5-step plan (steps 1–2 done) + `06_current.md` — current status
4. [`05a_codemap.md`](05a_codemap.md) — exactly what code has been changed so far vs. upstream
5. [`05b_remote.md`](05b_remote.md) — hosts, paths, venv build (with gotchas already hit once)
6. [`09_commands.md`](09_commands.md) — actual commands to run, incl. resubmitting the paused fine-tune
7. [`Ah_for_human.md`](Ah_for_human.md) — §3 has the open decision blocking resubmission
8. [`08r_gpt_review.md`](08r_gpt_review.md) — pre-fine-tuning review (historical; findings now applied)
9. others as needed

> [!TIP]
> `~/dev/openvla/docs/04s_openvla_oft_feasibility.md` is the investigation that started this
> project — read it for the reasoning behind nearly every non-obvious choice in this repo's docs.
> `~/dev/openvla/docs/` more broadly has the dataset conversion history, the discretization and
> gripper-hardware caveats that apply here too, and the `DevolInference` serving contract this
> project's future `serve.py` needs to keep speaking. That repo also currently has this project's
> new/renamed RLDS builder packages, **uncommitted** — see `Ah_for_human.md`§3 Q7.
